instruction: Mark all emails in the local Bills folder as read

rules.sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messages WHERE folderID = 13) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messageAttributes WHERE attributeID = 59 AND value = 1 AND messageID IN (SELECT id FROM messages WHERE folderID = 13));

metadata.explanation: Task requires marking all emails in Bills folder (folderID=13) as read. There are 2 emails (messageID 44, 45) in this folder. The evaluator uses run_sqlite3 to check that attribute 59 (read flag) has value 1 for ALL messages in the Bills folder. The SQL query verifies that the count of messages in folderID 13 equals the count of messages with the read attribute set.
metadata.verification: Verified by querying the Thunderbird database: folderID 13 contains 2 emails (IDs 44, 45). Attribute 59 represents the 'read' flag in Thunderbird. The SQL query checks for messages marked as read in the Bills folder.

llm_judge_reasons: SQL query correctly verifies that ALL emails in Bills folder (folderID=13) are marked as read by comparing total message count with read message count
Left side of equality: COUNT(*) FROM messages WHERE folderID=13 gets total messages in Bills folder
Right side of equality: COUNT(*) of messageAttributes with attributeID=59 (read flag) and value=1 for messages in folderID=13
Equality check ensures 100% of emails are marked as read, not just partial
Postconfig correctly closes Thunderbird to ensure database is flushed before verification
Database-level verification is reliable and appropriate for this task
